name: lattice
description: Lattice — the grid underneath. Type one sentence about a game and get an isometric, deterministic, zero-asset game you can play in a browser.

plugins.name: lattice
plugins.description: Build an isometric game from one sentence. Run /lattice followed by your idea — the plugin picks the shape, installs the kit, wires it, and opens the game in a browser so someone actually looks at it.
